name: Q*
description: Site-wide, query-independent quality score on 0-1 scale measuring trustworthiness and authority. Pages below 0.4 ineligible for featured snippets and prominent SERP features. 0.4 threshold independently confirmed by Candour Agency exploit across 800K domains. Largely static, representing domain trustworthiness. Confirmed hand-crafted (not ML). Google publicly denied 'domain authority' (2016-2019) while Q* existed internally. Score operates at subdomain level. Tied to E-E-A-T signals.

name: P*
description: Dynamic real-world engagement metric combining NavBoost user interaction data with link-based anchor text metrics. Measures how widely visited and well-linked a page is, powered by Chrome visit data.

name: T*
description: Query-dependent topicality score computing direct relevance through three sub-signals: Anchors (A), Body (B), and Clicks (C). Foundation score used in initial retrieval stage.

name: Anchors (A)
description: Sub-signal of T* measuring what the web says about a document through link context and descriptive anchor text pointing to pages.

name: Body (B)
description: Sub-signal of T* measuring what a document says about itself through on-page content analysis and term matching.

name: Clicks (C)
description: Sub-signal of T* measuring what users say about a document through click-through behavior, dwell time, and engagement patterns.

name: NavBoost
description: Core ranking system aggregating 13 months of user click data. Fundamentally 'just a big table' of click statistics (not ML). Achieves 91% accuracy improvements. Distinguishes good clicks, bad clicks, and last longest clicks. Reduces documents from tens of thousands to hundreds before ML processing. Contextually slices data by location and device type.

name: Glue
description: Internal super query log warehouse extending NavBoost to all SERP features. Captures query metadata, SERP layout, interaction signals (clicks, hovers, dwell time), and query interpretation data. Learns which features satisfy user intent for specific query types.

name: Instant Glue
description: Real-time pipeline variant of Glue delivering fresh user signals with ~10-minute latency on 24-hour data windows. Used for breaking news and trending queries.

name: QBST
description: Query Based Salient Terms. Memorization system identifying words appearing prominently on relevant pages. Trained on query and click data. Used in initial retrieval phase to identify large candidate document set.

name: goodClicks
description: Positive interaction clicks indicating successful user outcomes with extended dwell time on destination pages.

name: badClicks
description: Unsuccessful search result clicks where users immediately return to SERP (pogo-sticking), indicating dissatisfaction.

name: lastLongestClicks
description: Final result clicked with significant dwell time. Strongest satisfaction indicator in NavBoost system.

name: unsquashedClicks
description: Raw, unprocessed user interaction click data before anti-spam normalization is applied.

name: squashedClicks
description: Normalized click signals after squashing function prevents click signal dominance against manipulation. Prevents outliers from dominating rankings.

name: unicornClicks
description: High-value user interactions representing exceptionally strong engagement signals within NavBoost.

name: chrome_trans_clicks
description: Chrome browser transition click tracking signal fed directly into NavBoost popularity scoring. Leverages Chrome's 65%+ browser market share.

name: uniqueChromeViews
description: Aggregated unique Chrome browsing metrics measuring total site views from Chrome browser data, feeding into P* popularity signal.

name: chromeInTotal
description: Total Chrome browser data integration signal for authority measurement across all browsing sessions.

name: CRAPS
description: Click and Results Prediction System. Processes aggregated click data into ranking adjustments and demotions. Core integration point for weighted user signals within NavBoost.

name: crapsNewUrlSignals
description: Encoded URL-level click and impression data within the CRAPS system for per-page behavioral scoring.

name: crapsNewHostSignals
description: Encoded host-level click and impression data within the CRAPS system for domain-level behavioral scoring.

name: IS Score
description: Information Satisfaction score on 100-point scale. Primary quality metric computed from 16,000 human raters worldwide. Used to train RankBrain, SpamBrain, Helpful Content System, and MUM models. Wikipedia removal would cause ~0.5 IS point loss.

name: IS4@5
description: Derivative IS metric for precision measurement of information satisfaction at position 5.

name: Mustang
description: Initial retrieval and first-pass scoring system operating at massive scale. Primary scoring and ranking system that reduces index matches from hundreds of thousands to tens of thousands before deeper processing.

name: SuperRoot
description: Query coordination and post-processing orchestration system managing the search pipeline flow.

name: Tangram
description: SERP assembly and layout system (evolved from 'Tetris'). Arranges blue links, universal features, and ads for optimal space and UX. Uses Instant Glue for freshness signals.

name: Twiddlers
description: Late-stage ranking filters making final result adjustments. Series of re-ranking functions modifying results post-Mustang retrieval. Corrective mini-algorithms refining results.

name: QualityBoost
description: Re-ranking function specifically for overall quality assessment within the Twiddler framework.

name: Freshness Twiddler
description: Adjusts rankings based on content timeliness within the Twiddler framework. Promotes fresh content and demotes stale results for time-sensitive queries.

name: RankEmbed
description: Primary deep learning signal using dual encoder model that embeds queries and documents into shared space. Trained on one month of search data. Identifies additional documents beyond traditional retrieval.

name: RankEmbedBERT
description: BERT-enhanced version of RankEmbed. Dual encoder architecture using dot product similarity (not cosine). Trained on exactly 70 days of search logs plus human quality rater scores. Particularly effective for long-tail search understanding. Court mandated sharing of user-side training data. Requires periodic retraining on fresh data.

name: DeepRank
description: BERT-based neural network ranking system requiring both language understanding and world knowledge. Can decompose into traditional signal equivalents. Trained on user data.

name: eDeepRank
description: Enhanced DeepRank using BERT and transformers designed for decomposable analysis. Engineers can audit exactly why the LLM ranks a page at a given position. One of only two LLM-based ranking signals (with RankBrain).

name: RankBrain
description: ML system adjusting scores for top 20-30 documents. Trained on 13 months of click/query data, fine-tuned on IS ratings. Interprets novel and long-tail queries using historical search data and unsupervised learning.

name: BERT
description: Bidirectional contextual language model analyzing word relationships within queries. Refines hand-crafted signals with semantic understanding without replacing core logic.

name: MUM
description: Multitask Unified Model processing cross-language and multi-format (image/text) information. Too computationally expensive for runtime; trains smaller classifier models instead.

name: BR
description: Browser-derived popularity signal using Chrome data. Distinct from link-based authority, measures real-world browsing behavior and visit frequency.

name: Firefly
description: Site-level quality metrics signal within the NavBoost ecosystem. Provides site-wide behavioral quality assessment.

name: Tetris
description: Original name for the Tangram SERP assembly system. Promotes fresh content and demotes stale results for time-sensitive queries.

name: siteAuthority
description: Persistent composite site-level trust score representing overall domain reputation and authority.

name: NSR
description: Normalised Site Rank. Reliability and trustworthiness algorithm functioning as successor to PageRank for site-level quality assessment.

name: predictedDefaultNsr
description: Baseline quality score derived from content, behavior, and links used as default NSR value.

name: authorityPromotion
description: Positive modifier boost applied to pages from high-authority domains.

name: unauthoritativeScore
description: Direct negative signal quantifying lack of authoritativeness for a domain.

name: pandaDemotion
description: Site-wide demotion signal for low-quality content prevalence. Direct implementation of the Panda algorithm update in ranking pipeline.

name: babyPandaDemotion
description: Early Panda algorithm iteration demotion signal.

name: babyPandaV2Demotion
description: Later Panda evolution targeting rendered content quality assessment.

name: contentEffort
description: LLM-based labor and originality estimation for articles. Measures effort invested in content creation.

name: OriginalContentScore
description: Uniqueness measurement of content relative to the broader web. Assesses originality of a document.

name: GibberishScore
description: Detection of nonsensical or machine-generated text. Quality filter for content coherence.

name: KeywordStuffingScore
description: Over-optimization detection signal identifying pages with excessive keyword repetition.

name: DocLevelSpamScore
description: Document-level manipulation assessment score for detecting page-specific spam tactics.

name: lowQuality
description: ML-based quality score using site-to-vector embedding to classify overall content quality level.

name: shingleInfo
description: Duplicate content detection via overlapping word sequences (shingling) for identifying near-duplicate pages.

name: siteFocusScore
description: Quantifies a site's dedication to a specific topic. Measures topical authority and content focus.

name: siteRadius
description: Measures page deviation from a site's core theme. Higher values indicate topic drift from site focus.

name: navDemotion
description: Demotion signal for poor on-site navigation and user experience based on NavBoost behavioral data.

name: serpDemotion
description: Demotion signal triggered by SERP pogo-sticking behavior where users repeatedly bounce back from results.

name: clutterScore
description: Site-level penalization for distracting and intrusive page elements affecting user experience.

name: adsDensityInterstitialViolationStrength
description: Scaled 0-1000 strength of ad density and interstitial policy violations on mobile pages.

name: mobileCwv
description: Core Web Vitals field data for mobile devices. Measures LCP, FID/INP, and CLS.

name: desktopCwv
description: Core Web Vitals field data for desktop devices.

name: ymylHealthScore
description: Health and medical content authority assessment for Your Money Your Life topics.

name: ymylNewsScore
description: YMYL news topic authority and credibility assessment signal.

name: chard
description: Authority signal specifically for YMYL domains. Named authority component for health, finance, and safety topics.

name: productReviewPPromotePage
description: Page-level promotion signal for high-quality product review content.

name: productReviewPDemotePage
description: Page-level demotion signal for poor quality product review content.

name: productReviewPUhqPage
description: Ultra High Quality classification for exceptional product review pages. Top-tier review quality signal.

name: ugcScore
description: General user-generated content quality assessment score.

name: ugcDiscussionEffortScore
description: Effort and quality measurement for discussion threads and forum-style user-generated content.

name: isAuthor
description: Boolean identification of distinct authorship on a page.

name: authorObfuscatedGaiaStr
description: Obfuscated author identity and credential storage linked to Google's GAIA identity system.

name: anchorMismatchDemotion
description: Penalizes topically irrelevant inbound anchor text that doesn't match page content.

name: IsAnchorBayesSpam
description: Boolean Bayesian classifier for detecting unnatural anchor text patterns indicative of link manipulation.

name: exactMatchDomainDemotion
description: Demotion signal for low-quality exact-match keyword domains (EMD update implementation).

name: spamrank
description: Score measuring a page's tendency to link to spam content. Penalizes outbound linking to spam sites.

name: scamness
description: Scaled 0-1023 fraud and deception likelihood score for detecting scam pages.

name: topicEmbeddingsVersionedData
description: Versioned topic embedding vectors for semantic topic classification and understanding.

name: site2vecEmbeddingEncoded
description: Site-level vector embedding encoding for representing entire domains in semantic space.

name: EntityAnnotations
description: Semantic entity recognition and linking annotations within documents.

name: asteroidBeltIntents
description: Intent classification system determining the type and specificity of user search intent.

name: queriesForWhichOfficial
description: Identifies queries where a domain is the official authoritative source (brand signal).

name: freshboxArticleScores
description: Timeliness scoring signal for article content freshness assessment.

name: semanticDateInfo
description: Semantic extraction of publication and update dates from page content.

name: lastSignificantUpdate
description: Timestamp tracking meaningful content changes, distinguishing significant updates from trivial edits.

name: isHotdoc
description: Boolean flag for trending and timely content receiving freshness boost.

name: isSmartphoneOptimized
description: Tri-state mobile-friendliness classification signal for smartphone optimization.

name: badSslCertificate
description: Invalid SSL certificate detection signal used as negative trust indicator.

name: brickAndMortarStrengthScore
description: Physical business presence authority score for local search ranking.

name: geotopicality
description: Geographic relevance score measuring alignment between page content and query location.

name: experimentalQstarSignal
description: General Q* experimentation framework for testing quality score modifications.

name: hostAge
description: Domain age signal used to sandbox new sites for 3-6 months in serving time. Contradicts Google's public denial of a 'sandbox' for new sites. Newer domains face initial trust limitations until sufficient behavioral data accumulates.

name: titlematchScore
description: Query-to-title relevance alignment score measuring how well a page title matches search queries.

name: avgTermWeight
description: Content emphasis measurement via font sizing analysis. Evaluates visual prominence of terms on page.

name: smallPersonalSite
description: Site type categorization flag identifying small personal websites for differentiated ranking treatment.

name: onsiteProminence
description: Internal authority measurement of a page's prominence within its own site based on user interaction patterns.

name: patternLevel
description: NavBoost aggregation level: URL, host/path, or parent domain. Controls topical neighborhood effect propagation.

name: Alexandria
description: Google's primary indexing engine responsible for building and maintaining the search index.

name: TeraGoogle
description: Long-term document storage system for maintaining the full web archive.

name: Trawler
description: Google's web crawling system responsible for discovering and fetching web pages.

name: HtmlrenderWebkitHeadless
description: Headless WebKit-based JavaScript rendering system for indexing dynamic content.

name: MAGIT
description: Gemini-based system generating AI Overviews in search results. Fine-tuned on search data.

name: isSmearedSignal
description: Flag indicating pattern-based signal application across URL clusters. When direct data is sparse, signals are propagated from related URLs.

name: RankEmbedNearestNeighbors
description: Video content matching via embedding nearest neighbor search for multimedia ranking.

name: DotProductSimilarity
description: Primary semantic similarity metric used in RankEmbed (NOT cosine similarity). Measures query-document relevance in embedding space.

name: ThreePillarsOfRanking
description: Google's foundational ranking framework: Body (document content), Anchors (web mentions), User-interactions (clicks, attention, swipes). Core architectural principle revealed in trial exhibits.

name: 18SearchQualityAspects
description: 18 quality dimensions: relevance, page quality, popularity, freshness, localization, language, centrality, topical diversity, personalization, web ecosystem, mobile-friendliness, social fairness, optionalization, adult content demotion, spam detection, authority, privacy, spell correction control.

name: PredocTwiddlers
description: Lightweight re-ranking category processing hundreds of URLs with fast heuristics for deduplication, diversity enforcement, and filtering before deeper analysis.

name: LazyTwiddlers
description: Granular re-ranking category operating on top 20-30 results using full metadata for fine-grained adjustments after initial scoring.

name: YouTubeDensityTwiddler
description: Manages video result density in SERPs to prevent YouTube overrepresentation in search results.

name: OfficialPageTwiddler
description: Boosts official brand and authoritative pages in rankings for navigational and brand queries.

name: BlogCategorizer
description: Classifies and categorizes blog content for appropriate SERP treatment and diversity balancing.

name: BadURLsCategorizer
description: Identifies and categorizes problematic URLs for demotion or filtering in search results.

name: DMCAFilter
description: Twiddler that filters or demotes URLs with DMCA copyright takedown notices from search results.

name: SocialLikesAnnotator
description: Annotates and potentially boosts results with strong social engagement signals (likes, shares).

name: chromeFormSubmissions
description: Chrome browser form submission tracking as engagement signal. Indicates deeper user interaction with site functionality.

name: chromeScrollingIntensity
description: Chrome browser scrolling depth and intensity measurement as content engagement signal.

name: chromePurchaseActivity
description: Chrome browser purchase and transaction activity tracking as commercial engagement signal.

name: Multiverse
description: Structured data feed pipeline ingesting data from multiple sources into Google's Knowledge Graph and search index.

name: QueryUnderstandingService
description: QUS: Central query processing system that interprets, classifies, and enriches search queries before they reach the ranking pipeline.

name: GoogleWebServer
description: GWS: The serving layer responsible for assembling and delivering final search results to users.

name: DocID
description: Per-document profile system tracking popularity signals, quality measures, technical metadata, and spam scores that evolve with user interactions over time.

name: Priors
description: Algorithm scoring choices based on historical popularity and selection frequency. Biases results toward previously successful outcomes for similar queries.

name: SigmoidCombination
description: Sigmoid functions and threshold engineering used to combine and normalize individual ranking signals into composite scores. Core signal blending mechanism.

name: PageRankSeedDistance
description: Modern PageRank implementation measuring distance from trusted seed sites rather than raw link counting. Emphasizes topical proximity to known-good sources.

name: CrawlFrequencyFromEngagement
description: Crawl frequency determined by user engagement data. Higher engagement pages are crawled more frequently, creating a feedback loop between popularity and freshness.

name: LinearWeightedFormula
description: 100+ raw signals combined into top-level scores via linear weighted formulas. Primary signal aggregation method for hand-crafted signals.

name: DefaultBias
description: Choice architecture exploiting default bias makes switching cognitively difficult. Default effects stronger on mobile than desktop. Locks 33-50% of U.S. search queries through distribution agreements ($26.3B in 2021).

name: DataScaleAdvantage
description: Virtuous cycle: query volume drives click data, which drives ranking quality, which drives more queries. Competitors only access ~17% of U.S. search traffic. Google processes 8.3B queries daily.

name: HandCraftedSignalDominance
description: Vast majority of Google's ranking signals are hand-crafted, not ML-based. Only RankBrain and DeepRank use LLM technologies. All other signals manually developed by engineers.

name: NavBoostAccuracy
description: NavBoost achieves 91% accuracy improvements in search result ranking. Contradicts Google's public characterization of clicks as 'noisy signals'.

name: HostAgeSandbox
description: New domains sandboxed for 3-6 months via hostAge attribute. Contradicts Google's public denial of a 'sandbox' for new sites. Used at serving time to limit fresh spam.

name: GlueSERPInteractions
description: Glue's comprehensive SERP interaction logging: query text, user location and device, SERP layout, click patterns, mouseover events, dwell time per result, scroll depth, and query reformulations.

name: RankEmbed70DayTraining
description: RankEmbed BERT trained on exactly 70 days of search logs combined with human quality rater scores. Requires periodic retraining on fresh data to maintain accuracy.

name: QstarFeaturedSnippetThreshold
description: Sites with Q* score below 0.4 are disqualified from appearing in featured snippets and other prominent SERP features. Key threshold for content visibility.

name: NavBoostLocationSlice
description: NavBoost contextually slices click data by geographic location, providing location-specific ranking adjustments based on regional user behavior patterns.

name: NavBoostDeviceSlice
description: NavBoost contextually slices click data by device type (mobile/desktop/tablet), providing device-specific ranking adjustments.

name: OlderClickDataValue
description: Older historical click data sometimes more valuable than fresh click data depending on query context. Not all queries benefit from recency in click signals.

name: 400BDocumentIndex
description: Google indexes approximately 400 billion documents. Scale of the search index confirmed under sworn testimony.

name: eDeepRankDecomposable
description: eDeepRank designed for decomposable analysis: engineers can audit exactly why the LLM-based system ranks a page at a given position. Uses BERT/Transformers architecture.

name: StaticPageQuality
description: Page quality assessment is mostly static, representing site-wide trustworthiness rather than query-dependent relevance. Not recalculated per query.

name: ContentDerivedQuality
description: Most of Google's quality signal is derived from the webpage content itself, not from external signals like links or user behavior. Body (B) signal is the primary content-derived metric.

name: SearchOrgScale
description: Google's search organization comprises 5,000-10,000 employees. Proposed remedies would divert 1,000-2,000 employees (~20%) from search development.

name: DomainAuthorityDenial
description: Google publicly denied 'domain authority' as a ranking factor (2016-2019) while internal documents confirm both Q* and siteAuthority existed as active domain-level quality signals.

name: NavBoostTableNotML
description: NavBoost is fundamentally 'just a big table' of click data, not an ML system. It aggregates and looks up user interaction statistics rather than using machine learning models.

name: AlgorithmReconstructionRisk
description: Google admitted under oath that sharing click data, URLs, and search queries with competitors would make algorithm reconstruction feasible. Core reason Google opposes data-sharing remedies.

name: ConsensusScore
description: Google counts passages in content that agree with, contradict, or are neutral to the general web consensus on a topic. Generates a per-page consensus score affecting ranking eligibility per query. For debunking queries (e.g. 'is earth flat'), results are heavily consensus-aligned. For political/subjective topics, Google intentionally mixes consensus, neutral, and non-consensus content.

name: DebunkingQueryClassifier
description: Query classifier detecting debunking intent ('is X true?' queries). When triggered, search results are heavily consensus-aligned to prevent misinformation. Part of a broader query classification system including news score, medical classifier, and YMYL triggers.

name: RefinedQuerySemanticClass
description: Google classifies almost all queries into one of 8 refined query semantic classes (RQ classes). Distribution across 90M queries shows majority are 'short_fact' or 'bool' (yes/no type answers). These short-answer queries are most vulnerable to AI Overview displacement since Google can generate answers directly instead of sending traffic to websites.

name: ClickProbability
description: Per-result predicted click-through rate for every organic position. Google builds a prediction model of expected CTR. Results can over/underperform against this prediction. Not direct CTR in ranking, but a prediction model that factors into post-ranking adjustments. Google Ads Planner provides hints about estimated CTR. Confirmed across 90M queries in exploit data.

name: PredictingSiteQuality
description: Phrase model that predicts site quality for new domains without user data. Converts page content into numerical vector ('shape') and compares against known-quality sites. Explains why AI-generated content initially ranked well (LLM output matches 'good content' phrase patterns from training data) then got penalized when Google updated this prediction model. Referenced in Google patent as 'predicting site quality'.

name: SiteQualityThreshold
description: Sites with quality score below 0.4 are ineligible for featured snippets, People Also Ask, and other rich results. Confirmed across 800K domains in exploit data. Score operates at subdomain level (Google scores subdomains differently despite public claims they don't distinguish subdomains). Independently confirms DOJ testimony about Q* 0.4 threshold.
